t: This is Toynbee Street, a street in the London Borough of Tower Hamlets. It takes its name from Arnold Toynbee, who lived from 1852 to 1883. He was an English economic historian, and he cared a great deal about improving the living conditions of working people. Toynbee Hall in London was also named in his honour. So the name on the street sign belongs to a man remembered for his social commitment as much as for his history writing.
